Actress Anupama Parameswaran Discusses Narcissistic Abuse in Past Relationship

Actress Anupama Parameswaran has spoken about experiencing narcissistic abuse for two years during a past relationship. She described the experience as living with 'Anniyan' and indicated she is now healing. The actress's statements come amid breakup rumors with Dhruv Vikram. Parameswaran stated that the abuse involved manipulative behavior and control.
